studies.title: Sailing on the monsoon
studies.caption: Greek pilots from Egypt learn what Arab and Indian sailors knew: the summer wind blows steadily from the southwest, the winter wind back again.
studies.prompt: Broad stern-quarter view of an ancient merchant sailing ship crossing open Arabian Sea around the first centuryCE with steady seasonal wind filling a square sail, amphora cargo secured below gunwale, experienced sailors working ropes. Deep open water and cloud bands, no compass or modern rigging.
